newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble dips on T-bill profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Rouble dips on T-bill profit-taking.

text.p: The rouble eased on Wednesday as funds flowed into the currency market on profit-taking by Treasury bill investors, dealers said.
roubles/dollar May 28 midday May 28 early May 27 close

"The dollar edged up as somebody was taking profits from T-bill investments. Besides, there was no active dollar selling ahead of (today's T-bill and OFZ bond) auctions," CS First Boston dealer Sergei Koshelenko said.
Today the Russian Finance Ministry auctioned 6.50 trillion roubles of 308-day GKO discount Treasury bills and 4.00 trillion roubles of 728-day OFZ bonds.
Dealers said the rouble's decline was likely to be brief, being just a short-term speculative bearish trend.
"The market has been by the lower central bank's rate (dollar-wise) for a long time and today many banks got hold of a chance to start buying," Tokobank dealer Pavel Shirshov said.
